questions.question: The company implemented a *strategic pivot* in response to market shifts, shifting focus from consumer electronics to industrial automation. What does this term mean in this context?
options: a sudden, temporary change in direction
a long-term, planned shift in focus to a new area of business
a minor adjustment to existing product lines
a complete abandonment of the original business model
